levels.surface: أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد

notes: «- ابن عرفة يعني الحسن -»: «يعني الحسن» is an identifying gloss in the text, not a transmitter; it is left out and the name stands as «ابن عرفة»
«11-2» is a report number, not part of the chain
the last link is Jabir, who relates the Jewish man's question and the Prophet's answer; the Prophet is the end
